definition.title: Key conflicts and replacement lifecycle
definition.expectedInvariant: Disjoint keys coexist; overlapping other slots conflict; same-slot replacement must satisfy both fee thresholds.
preconditions: Fresh funded sender with sequence zero
All replacements occur before TTL expiry

limitations: Fresh staged-fork mining fixture; manual sidecar bundling and ordinary canonical transfers.
Seed identifies action order, not private signing keys; fresh accounts are random.
Only the explicitly defined actions are checked; terminal/TTL and submitted-entry exceptions are outside this run.
